generic_root_cause: Excel census workbooks may contain formatting artifacts, cell styles, or formulas extending across thousands of empty columns (up to column 16,384/XFD), causing severe performance degradation, runaway delimiter expansion, and memory saturation if boundaries are not strictly truncated at structured table extent.
applicable_conditions: Worksheet max_column exceeds structured tabular header columns
Consecutive empty column gap of >= 5 columns across all rows
Presence of phantom or styled blank cells beyond valid data range (e.g. columns A:M vs A:XFD)

conditions: max_column exceeds tabular range by >= 5 empty columns

root_cause.summary: Truncate worksheet ingestion at the first column where >= 5 consecutive columns are completely empty across all data rows.

preconditions: contiguous structured table headers identified in columns A:N
exclusions: do not truncate valid multi-tier tables with single empty spacer columns

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Wellfit Technologies worksheet extent audit (Columns A:M bounded)
